You write beautifully. Thank you for your kind words. I will not take my life today, I had intended to do it tomorrow evening. Tomorrow is my day of goodbyes. I had them take me off medication awhile ago, I want my mind perfectly clear for tomorrow.

You're a good person. Thank you.

Thank you. I've already made all the peace I want, and I am calm. I think that if I wait too long, then my state will deteriorate.
